meta.name: {community} Rules and Regulations
meta.notice: Sections 0 and 1 apply to the Discord and to competitive play. Section A covers matches, scrims and team organisation.
meta.philosophy: The goal is fair and balanced moderation that promotes positive behaviour and holds people accountable. Punishments listed here are the standard outcome, not the ceiling: staff may escalate where severity clearly warrants it, and every escalation is recorded on the case.
meta.appeals: Every ban may be appealed in the appeal server. A permanent ban is the end of an escalation ladder, not the starting point, and it remains appealable. Rule 0.5 is the sole exception and is never lifted.

sections.title: How and Where We Moderate
sections.summary: Scope of moderation and the exceptions to it
sections.description:
Moderation covers the public channels of {community} and the servers connected to it, including public lobbies, ranked codes, scrimmages and matches.

Private conversations are not moderated by default. The exceptions are settings where every party consents to staff review, and serious offences, which are actioned wherever they occur.

Staff reserve the right to moderate beyond these guidelines where it is necessary to keep the community respectful. Punishments listed in this document are the standard outcome; staff may escalate where severity clearly warrants it, and every escalation is recorded on the case.

sections.title: Racism
sections.description: It is completely unacceptable to use language that is racially charged, which includes slurs and offensive terminology.

clauses.title: Discriminatory or stereotypical language based on race, excluding slurs
Using racial slurs
clauses.note: Context is not taken into consideration.

clauses.title: Sharing racist or discriminatory media
clauses.note: Context is taken into consideration. The first offence runs from a one to three month ban and the second from six months to permanent, so staff pick the tier that fits the severity.

sections.title: Homophobia and Transphobia
sections.description: We oppose any action that harms LGBTQ+ members of the community.

clauses.title: Hateful language toward LGBTQ+ people, including deliberate misgendering
clauses.note: If it is not directed at anyone, a warning is given first. Ignoring or arguing with that warning moves to the ladder below.

clauses.title: Homophobic or transphobic profile content, including avatar, bio and name
clauses.note: Staff request the content is removed first. Failing to comply carries the ban below.

clauses.title: Using LGBTQ+ terms as an insult, such as calling something gay

sections.title: NSFW
sections.description: Content that is not safe for work is not promoted or shared here.

clauses.title: Minor NSFW content, such as suggestive jokes, mild profanity and innuendo
clauses.note: The content is removed alongside the first warning.

clauses.title: Medium NSFW content, such as partial nudity, heavy profanity or mild violence
Major NSFW content, such as explicit material, full nudity or graphic violence
NSFW profile content
clauses.note: Staff request the content is removed first. Failing to comply carries the ban below.

sections.title: Harassment
sections.description: There is zero tolerance for cyberbullying and targeted aggression, whether it happens in public or in private.

clauses.title: Repeatedly voicing negative opinions about a member beyond banter
clauses.note: Members who are consistently involved in disputes receive longer mutes, and bans where the severity warrants it.

clauses.title: Sexual harassment
clauses.note: Threatening rape is a permanent ban regardless of context.

clauses.title: Spam pinging, or pinging without permission

sections.title: Pedophilia
sections.summary: Grooming and inappropriate conduct toward minors
sections.description: There is zero tolerance for grooming and for any inappropriate action by an adult toward a child. Punishments under this rule are never lifted and cannot be appealed.

clauses.title: Any offence under this rule
clauses.note: This decision is final and is never appealable.

sections.title: Anti-Religious Conduct
sections.description: The community stays religiously neutral and prioritises empathy over argument.

clauses.title: Religious debate
clauses.note: Applies to every party involved in the debate.

clauses.title: Mocking a religion or dismissing someone's beliefs

sections.title: Sexism
sections.summary: Respect for people of every gender
sections.description: Individuals of all genders are respected here, and gender stereotypes are rejected.

sections.title: Politics
sections.description: Political discussion is expected to stay civil, reasoned and free from personal attacks.

clauses.title: Expressing support for abhorrent political figures
Disrespecting or ridiculing someone for their political views

sections.title: Ableism
sections.description: Discriminatory behaviour toward disabled individuals is not tolerated.

clauses.title: Indirect use of ableist slurs
clauses.note: Neutral, technical or historical use of the word is not punished.

sections.title: Hacking and Personal Data
sections.summary: Malicious cyber activity and private information
sections.description: There is zero tolerance for malicious cyber activity and for the misuse of anyone's personal information.

clauses.title: Disclosing or acquiring personal information without permission
clauses.note: Applied after staff have investigated.

clauses.title: Using personal information to blackmail someone
Impersonating someone else's profile
clauses.note: Staff ask for the profile to be changed first. The ban stands until it is changed.

clauses.title: Faking evidence or filing a false report
clauses.note: Punished to the severity of whatever was falsely reported, so file the case under that rule and record this clause in the reason.

sections.title: Competitive Sabotage
sections.description: Fair play is essential. Tactics that sabotage another team outside of the game itself are punished here.

clauses.title: Staff bias
clauses.note: Reported to an admin, who investigates. No punishment is filed from this clause.

clauses.title: Deliberately disrupting scheduling
clauses.note: The first offence is a forced forfeit applied by staff. The permanent ban applies to the captain.

clauses.title: Poaching or bribing players
clauses.note: The first offence is a forced forfeit applied by staff.

sections.title: Cheating
sections.summary: Cheating in public and competitive play
sections.description:
There is zero tolerance for cheating in the public and competitive scenes.

Allowed headsets: Meta Quest 2, 3, 3S and Pro; Valve Index and Steam Frame; all Pimax, HTC Vive and BigScreen VR headsets; HP Reverb G2; Lenovo Explorer; DPVR E4.

Allowed SideQuest settings on Quest: texture size up to 3072, refresh rate between 60 and 120 Hz, FFR and chromatic aberration at any value, capture size, FPS and bitrate at default or below, experimental mode off, MTP and full rate off.

Allowed SteamVR settings: refresh rate between 72 and 120 Hz, render resolution up to 200, resolution multiplier up to 200, prediction up to 0.00, override world scale off.

clauses.title: Using PCVR by connecting a standalone headset in an official match
Elongating reach, including world scale, sticks and extended grips
PSA, crouch jumping or the rec room glitch
A captain knowingly fielding cheaters or banned players
clauses.note: The team is disqualified alongside the captain's ban.

clauses.title: Software or techniques that tamper with game performance
Misrepresenting hardware or configuration, or evading staff questions about it

sections.title: Self Promotion and Advertising
sections.description: Advertising other leagues and pre-approved Discord servers is permitted. Anything else is covered below.

clauses.title: Promoting in a channel that is not designated for it

sections.title: Improper Chat Behaviour
sections.description: Chat stays readable for everyone.

clauses.title: Spamming, copypasta or walls of text

sections.title: Cooperation with Staff
sections.description: Staff have to be able to do their job without being fought at every step.

sections.title: Enabling and Supporting Banned Members
sections.description: A ban only works if the rest of the community does not work around it.

clauses.title: Allowing banned players into competitive activities
Helping a banned player take part, or helping them evade a ban
Defending banned players in public chat

sections.title: Voice Chat
sections.description: Every rule in this document applies in voice chat as well as in text.

clauses.title: Using a voice changer
clauses.note: The final tier is a permanent server mute.

clauses.title: Disrupting voice chat with soundboards or mic spam
clauses.note: Mutes stack if it keeps happening.

clauses.title: Arguments and conflicts in voice chat
clauses.note: A minor argument is one day, a medium argument one week and a major argument one month. Staff pick the tier that fits rather than counting offences.

clauses.title: Encouraging arguments in voice chat
clauses.note: Mutes stack if it keeps happening.

sections.title: Match Start and Preparation
sections.summary: Getting a match started on time
sections.description:
Teams play 4v4, or 3v3 with staff permission. Team members wear matching colours, the two teams wear opposite colours, cosmetics are uniform, and every player carries the team tag in their Discord name. Mods are uninstalled before play.

Before a match the referee confirms player mutes, confirms the teams, verifies the requirements above, and positions themselves in the gazebo, on the stump or out of the map.

Casters use the supplied OBS overlay and settings, stay able to hear the referee, keep commentary on topic, and verify everything works before the match.

At the start of a round the tagged players stand in the gazebo. During the round the taggers tag the other team, and tagging your own team is permitted.

sections.title: Round Resets and Technical Difficulties
sections.description:
A player who is away without explanation, or not ready, gets a ten second countdown from the referee before the round starts without them.

A player who is away and asks for time gets thirty seconds. Asking repeatedly across two or more rounds per team falls under the stalling rules.

If a runner disconnects mid round there is no reset. A player who rejoins cannot help tag, and the round stays 3v4.

A team may reset once per scrim to get a different starting tagger.

sections.title: Stalling
sections.description: Stalling tactics slow a match down and are penalised by the referee first and by the moderation team after that.

clauses.title: Intentionally impeding the advancement of the game
clauses.note: The second offence is sitting out a round, the third forfeits a point and the fourth forfeits the match. Those are applied by the referee. A fifth offence from the same player in a season starts stacking one month bans.

clauses.title: Wasting time between rounds
clauses.note: Each team may stop three times for a short break, between ten seconds and one minute at the referee's discretion. Going beyond that is treated as a second offence under clause A.

clauses.title: Intentional map hopping
clauses.note: The first offence forfeits the round. The second forfeits the match and carries the ban below. Anything beyond that stacks one month bans.

sections.title: Prohibited Tactics
sections.summary: Tactics that are not skill based
sections.description: Matches are decided by skill and fair mechanics.

clauses.title: Hiding strategies
clauses.note: Identified by the referee. The second offence forfeits the round and the third forfeits the match. A fourth starts stacking one month bans.

sections.title: Substitutes, Matches and Scrims
sections.summary: Who may play for a team
sections.description: Rosters stay honest so that every match is played on a level field.

clauses.title: Using banned players in an unofficial scrim
clauses.note: Under an official team name: a very strong warning, then instant disbandment. Without an official team name: a warning, then the captain is replaced, then disbandment.

clauses.title: Using substitutes improperly in an official match
clauses.note: A substitute has to already be on the team, and may only come in at the start of a round. Playing someone from outside the team forfeits the match instantly and disbands the team.

sections.title: Respecting Referees
sections.description: There is zero tolerance for mistreating a referee. Referee decisions are final during the match.

clauses.title: Toxicity toward a referee, including cursing and name calling
clauses.note: One player: warning, then sitting out a round, then ejection from the match and a one match suspension. A whole team: warning, then a thirty second tagger hold, then a point deduction and a final warning, then forfeit. Everyone involved: warning, second warning, then the match is rescheduled with a different referee.

clauses.title: Arguing with referee decisions
clauses.note: Referee decisions are final. Appeals go to the moderation team after the match. A player or team may make a brief case, and it escalates only if it turns disrespectful.

sections.title: Contracts
sections.summary: Trial periods, contracts and bracket lock
sections.description:
A new player has a three day trial period and cannot play official matches during it. A match admin may approve an exception for special causes. Leaving the team resets the trial.

After the trial a player is on a two week contract, which is seventeen days including the trial. A player who is kicked stays bound for two weeks, a player who leaves stays bound for two weeks, and a team cannot contract a player from a team it is playing that week.

Once the elimination bracket starts, rosters are locked. A team may kick a player but cannot replace them except in a critical condition, and cannot fill a spot with a player who was locked to another roster.

sections.title: Team Format
sections.description:
A team holds at most ten players and at least four. A team that drops below four has three days to find a fourth.

Players must be thirteen or older. An underage player is temporarily banned until they reach thirteen.

A team has one captain and one co-captain. The captain is counted separately from the playing roster, and takes a roster spot if they play.

sections.title: Tardiness
sections.description:
Both teams arrive five minutes before the scheduled time. Staff record a strike when a team is reported late, and three strikes forfeit the match.

Missing players have five minutes after the scheduled time. Beyond that the match is forfeited or rescheduled for the same day.

Names and colours are ready within the five minute window. Not being ready is penalised under the stalling rules.

sections.title: {community} Codes
sections.description: Competitive codes only work if everyone in them is there to play.

clauses.title: What counts as griefing a code
clauses.note: Griefing includes not participating, code squatting, playing without competitive intent, hiding, and activating game features such as Lucy or Lava. Punishments are filed under clause B.
